stories.title: Helicóptero com cantor Rick é encontrado; não há sobreviventes

en.title: Helicopter with singer Rick is found; there are no survivors
en.summary: A helicopter carrying Brazilian singer Rick disappeared while traveling from Porto Belo to São Joaquim in Santa Catarina state. The aircraft was found with no survivors; four other people were also on board.

stories.title: Rick, da dupla com Renner, deixa esposa e dois filhos

en.title: Rick, from the duo with Renner, leaves a wife and two children
en.summary: Singer Rick, who died in a helicopter crash in Santa Catarina, was 59 years old and married with two children. The aircraft was carrying five people total when it disappeared during a flight to São Joaquim.

stories.title: VÍDEO: 'Você não tem que ser rico. Tem que ter amigo rico', brincou cantor Rick ao entrar com amigo Bruno Avelar em helicóptero que caiu em Santa Catarina

en.title: VIDEO: 'You don't have to be rich. You have to have a rich friend,' joked singer Rick as he entered the helicopter that crashed in Santa Catarina with friend Bruno Avelar
en.summary: Singer Rick posted a video before the fatal helicopter crash in Santa Catarina, joking with businessman Bruno Avelar as they prepared to board the aircraft that would crash, killing five people.

stories.title: VÍDEO mostra último show de Rick em Campo Grande antes de morte em queda de helicóptero

en.title: VIDEO shows Rick's last show in Campo Grande before death in helicopter crash
en.summary: Video footage captures the last public performance by Rick and Renner duo on August 18 in Campo Grande. The singer died in a helicopter crash two days later while traveling in Santa Catarina.

stories.title: Veja vídeo dos destroços do helicóptero que levava o cantor Rick e mais quatro

en.title: See video of wreckage of helicopter carrying singer Rick and four others
en.summary: A helicopter carrying singer Rick from the duo Rick and Renner disappeared in Santa Catarina state. Wreckage with five bodies was found on Tuesday with no survivors, confirmed by the fire department.

stories.title: Morre Rick, da dupla com Renner, aos 59 anos, após queda de helicóptero

en.title: Rick, from the duo with Renner, dies at 59 after helicopter crash
en.summary: Singer Rick Sollo, age 59, from the country music duo Rick and Renner, died in a helicopter crash. The fire department confirmed his death on Tuesday.

stories.title: Quem foi Rick, da dupla Rick & Renner: cantor morreu aos 59 anos após queda de helicóptero

en.title: Who was Rick, from the duo Rick & Renner: singer died at 59 after helicopter crash
en.summary: Singer Rick from duo Rick and Renner died at age 59 in a Santa Catarina helicopter crash along with businessman Bruno Avelar and videomaker Paulo Soares. The pilot and copilot also perished in the accident.

stories.title: Quem era Bruno Avelar, empresário e influencer que morreu em acidente de helicóptero com o cantor Rick

en.title: Who was Bruno Avelar, businessman and influencer who died in helicopter accident with singer Rick
en.summary: Businessman and influencer Bruno Avelar, 41, from Minas Gerais died in a helicopter crash in Santa Catarina along with singer Rick and videomaker Paulo Soares. Five bodies were recovered from the wreckage with no survivors.

stories.title: Rick, da dupla com Renner, morre aos 59 anos; relembre a trajetória do cantor

en.title: Rick, of the duo with Renner, dies at 59 years old; remember the singer's trajectory
en.summary: Singer Rick from the musical duo Rick and Renner has died at age 59.

stories.title: Helicóptero do cantor Rick é encontrado em Santa Catarina; bombeiros dizem que não há sobreviventes

en.title: Singer Rick's helicopter is found in Santa Catarina; firefighters say there are no survivors
en.summary: Wreckage of a helicopter carrying singer Rick from the duo Rick and Renner was located in Santa Catarina on Tuesday after departing from Porto Belo on Monday. Five deaths have been confirmed with no survivors.

stories.title: Helicóptero com Rick é achado em SC; cantor e empresário ligado a Neymar morrem

en.title: Helicopter with Rick is found in SC; singer and businessman linked to Neymar die
en.summary: A helicopter carrying singer Rick and a businessman with connections to Neymar has been found in Santa Catarina, resulting in fatalities.

stories.title: Buscas por helicóptero com cantor Rick teve reforço de drone térmico em Santa Catarina

en.title: Search for helicopter with singer Rick received thermal drone support in Santa Catarina
en.summary: Rescue operations for the helicopter carrying singer Rick in Santa Catarina were assisted by thermal drone technology during the search efforts.

stories.title: Milei tenta renegociar acordo comercial com EUA por falta de votos no Congresso, diz agência

en.title: Milei seeks to renegotiate trade agreement with USA due to lack of congressional votes, agency says
en.summary: Argentina's government is attempting to renegotiate a commercial agreement with the United States signed in February after determining it lacks sufficient congressional support for approval. The US has rejected reopening negotiations.

stories.title: Rubio tenta aproximação com Lula no plenário da ONU após fala de Trump

en.title: Rubio attempts rapprochement with Lula at UN plenary following Trump speech
en.summary: The US Secretary of State attempted to interact with Brazil's president at the UN General Assembly after Trump's address, but the Brazilian leader left the plenary without engaging with the American delegation.

stories.title: Bombeiros encontram destroços de helicóptero do cantor Rick em SC; não há sobreviventes

en.title: Firefighters find wreckage of singer Rick's helicopter in SC; no survivors
en.summary: Firefighters in Santa Catarina located the wreckage of singer Rick's helicopter on Tuesday, which had been missing since Monday. All five people on board were confirmed dead.

stories.title: Lula: Acesso a minerais no país terá como contrapartida obrigatória geração de valor para o Brasil

en.title: Lula: Access to minerals in the country will require mandatory value generation for Brazil
en.summary: Brazil's president stated that access to the country's minerals will require technology transfer, value creation on Brazilian territory, and supply to national strategic sectors. He emphasized Brazil's critical minerals and rare earths are essential for global energy transition.

stories.title: Lula na ONU: Brasil não subestima desafio representado pelo crime organizado

en.title: Lula at the UN: Brazil does not underestimate the challenge posed by organized crime
en.summary: President Lula addressed the UN General Assembly, stating that Brazil acknowledges organized crime challenges but will not outsource responsibility for border defense, while remaining open to international cooperation.
